summary.text: Gale A. Brewer represents the 6th Council District on Manhattan's Upper West Side, which also includes Lincoln Square and Hell's Kitchen, and has done so since January 3, 2022, according to her Council page.
She chairs the Committee on Governmental Operations, State and Federal Legislation.

paragraphs.text: Her Council page says she is a member of the Committees on Aging, Consumer and Worker Protection, Contracts, Criminal Justice, Education and Immigration, and of the Progressive Caucus, and serves as co-chair of the Women's Caucus.
It points to laws passed with her office to prevent lithium-ion battery fires, expand the city's tree canopy and protect hourly workers.
